vectors.notes: G5: A7 weight per bucket (archive-building 1.0, colour-building 0.0, object 0.2), A3 the rest, hard switch; weighted sum of min-max scores. Buckets: p(building) > 0.5 from a logistic regression on A7 vectors (penalty 0.1, 14275 gallery images, 992 query entities left out, right on tune queries: T1 98.6% of 138, T3 100.0% of 99, T5 100.0% of 443, T8 99.6% of 232, T2 nan% of 0); a building photo is archive when its chroma spread (std of Cb, Cr) is under 2.0, else colour. Weights picked from the grid by mean hit@10 over T1, T2, T3, T5 (tune halves); G1 (archive-building 0.2, colour-building 0.2, object 0.2) split-half hit@10: T1 38.4, T2 36.6, T3 88.9, T5 58.2; G4 (archive-building 0.9, colour-building 0.9, object 0.2) split-half hit@10: T1 48.6, T2 31.2, T3 89.9, T5 60.5; G5 (archive-building 1.0, colour-building 0.0, object 0.2) split-half hit@10: T1 50.0, T2 40.3, T3 89.9, T5 60.5
